placeTitles.in_circle_not_gym: In the circle, not in the gym

fixtures.name: gym-enter-exit
fixtures.expectation: one interval confirmed at enter + 30 s and ended by the exit receipt

fixtures.name: region-blip
fixtures.expectation: a 4 s blip never confirms and leaves no interval

fixtures.name: quiet
fixtures.expectation: no events, no regions, no intervals

fixtures.name: gym-oscillation
fixtures.expectation: every exit clears a pending confirmation; a confirmed visit ends on the first exit

fixtures.name: gym-passby
fixtures.expectation: a 25 s pass-by receives an enter but never confirms

fixtures.name: gym-coverage-lost
fixtures.expectation: coverageLost closes the open visit at max(confirmedAt, lostAt) and cannot resurrect it

scenarios.title: Register the gym
scenarios.captainWords: I put in location for the gym
scenarios.refExpectation: Monitoring starts without region_monitoring_failed; requestState returns inside within 60 s while standing at the entrance
scenarios.prodExpectation: sameGymSaved = true; if Always is granted and auto-detect is on the region was registered (declared, not observable)

steps.text: Stand at the gym entrance. Tap Set gym here and stand still for 20 seconds.
In ExcerLock, save the same gym at the same entrance and radius, then confirm the checklist on the harness Home screen.

scenarios.title: Arrive on foot
scenarios.refExpectation: region enter within 0-120 s of crossing (iOS latency, reported); port confirms exactly +30 s after the enter receipt; sampled presence inside at the label
scenarios.prodExpectation: Card At gym and canary opened observed after confirm; before confirm the card should read not at gym

steps.text: Start at least 300 m away, in the Away place.
Walk to the gym. Tap I'm in the gym when you pass the front desk.
Wait until the reducer line reads confirmed, then tap ExcerLock shows... At gym and try a locked app.

scenarios.title: Stay there
scenarios.refExpectation: zero exit events during the window; the interval stays open; region presence must stay inside
scenarios.prodExpectation: both observations At gym and canary opened

steps.text: Stay inside the gym for at least 20 minutes, in the I'm in the gym place.
Tap ExcerLock shows... At gym about 10 minutes in.
Tap ExcerLock shows... At gym again before you leave, and try a locked app once.

scenarios.title: Use another app while there
scenarios.captainWords: click on another app when I am there
scenarios.refExpectation: the harness keeps receiving fixes in the background; no exit; the interval is unchanged
scenarios.prodExpectation: after returning the card still reads At gym; a canary opened from inside the other app is the strongest proof

steps.text: Be inside the gym in the I'm in the gym place.
Switch to another app and stay there 5 minutes, then tap Done.
Lock the phone for 5 minutes, then unlock it and tap Done.
Open the locked app from the other app and record what happened, then return to the recorder and tap Done.

scenarios.title: Leave
scenarios.refExpectation: region exit within 0-300 s of the label (iOS latency, reported); the interval's exitedAt is the exit receipt
scenarios.prodExpectation: after the exit the card is not present and a locked app is blocked; before the exit the card still reads At gym

steps.text: Be inside the gym in the I'm in the gym place and confirmed.
Walk out and at least 300 m away, then tap Away.
Record what ExcerLock shows now and whether a locked app opens.

scenarios.title: Leave and return
scenarios.refExpectation: two enters, one exit, two intervals; the second visit gets a fresh 30 s confirmation
scenarios.prodExpectation: a second At gym observation after the second confirmation

steps.text: Be inside the gym, in the I'm in the gym place, confirmed.
Walk out past the circle and tap Away.
Walk back in and tap I'm in the gym.

scenarios.title: Oscillate across the boundary
scenarios.captainWords: in the circle, everything around that
scenarios.refExpectation: flap count reported; each exit cancels a pending confirmation; a confirmed interval ends on the first exit
scenarios.prodExpectation: report how many times At gym was observed; every exit should flip the card back

steps.text: Walk across the circle edge six times, about a minute apart. Tap In the circle, not in the gym each time you are inside, and Away each time you are outside.

scenarios.title: Hover at the edge
scenarios.captainWords: right on the edge of the circle
scenarios.refExpectation: either state is acceptable; enter/exit counts and confirmations are reported as boundary behaviour, never as FP/FN
scenarios.prodExpectation: whatever is observed is reported

steps.text: Stand on the boundary line for 5 minutes and tap On the boundary line.

scenarios.title: Brief pass-by that must not count
scenarios.refExpectation: an enter may fire; the port must not confirm (exit before +30 s) and must open no interval
scenarios.prodExpectation: the card must never read At gym

steps.text: Walk straight through the circle without stopping. Tap Passing by, not stopping as the gym comes into view.
Tap Away once the gym is behind you.

scenarios.title: Drive-by
scenarios.refExpectation: usually no enter at all (iOS may not register a transient crossing); if there is an enter there is no confirmation
scenarios.prodExpectation: the card must never read At gym

steps.text: Drive past the gym in a vehicle. Tap Passing by, not stopping as it comes into view.
Tap Away once the gym is behind you.

scenarios.title: Arrive by vehicle, park inside the circle, walk in
scenarios.captainWords: park at the gym and walk in
scenarios.refExpectation: enter at or before the parked label; confirmation may complete in the car park, which is expected by the production model (no building test); report confirmed_before_in_gym_seconds
scenarios.prodExpectation: At gym may be observed before entering the building; reported

steps.text: Drive to the car park inside the circle and tap In the circle, not in the gym when you park.
Walk into the building and tap I'm in the gym at the desk.

scenarios.title: GPS drift and poor indoor accuracy
scenarios.captainWords: deep inside where GPS is bad
scenarios.refExpectation: sampled presence goes ambiguous or outside_certain on bad fixes; report spurious_exit_count and the accuracy at those fixes
scenarios.prodExpectation: if an exit reaches ExcerLock the card drops to not present and relief is lost; the observation after 15 minutes tells

steps.text: Go deep inside the gym, phone in a locker or bag, and stay in the I'm in the gym place for 15 minutes.
Tap ExcerLock shows... before the end of the 15 minutes.

scenarios.title: App killed and relaunched
scenarios.captainWords: kill the app while I'm in there
scenarios.refExpectation: the port is unaffected; the harness records whether its own events continued so the reader knows iOS did emit them
scenarios.prodExpectation: with no noteCoverageLost caller the visit stays open until a later exit arrives; this scenario yields a finding, not a pass/fail

steps.text: Be inside the gym, in the I'm in the gym place, confirmed.
Force-quit ExcerLock, wait 3 minutes, relaunch it, then tap I did this in ExcerLock... app force quit and app relaunched.
Reopen ExcerLock, then tap I did this in ExcerLock... app relaunched.
Walk away from the gym and tap Away.
Record what the ExcerLock card shows after relaunch and after leaving.

scenarios.title: Permission: When In Use only
scenarios.refExpectation: the harness still records everything with its own Always; the production auto path cannot exist
scenarios.prodExpectation: manual check-in should work: the person taps Check in and the harness Probe check-in records what a fresh fix says

steps.text: Set ExcerLock location to While Using only and switch auto-detect off. Tap I did this in ExcerLock... permission changed.
Walk to the gym from at least 300 m away and tap I'm in the gym at the desk.
In ExcerLock tap Check in on the gym card, then tap Done here.
Tap Probe check-in on the harness and record what ExcerLock shows after a minute.

scenarios.title: Permission denied
scenarios.refExpectation: the harness still records with its own permission; production gets nothing
scenarios.prodExpectation: the card never reads At gym and a locked app stays blocked

steps.text: Deny location for ExcerLock in iOS Settings, then tap I did this in ExcerLock... permission changed.
Walk to the gym from at least 300 m away and tap I'm in the gym at the desk.
Record what ExcerLock shows and whether a locked app opens.

scenarios.title: Approximate location (precise off)
scenarios.refExpectation: region monitoring is not available under reduced accuracy; record region_monitoring_failed or the absence of events
scenarios.prodExpectation: the card never reads At gym and manual check-in fails

steps.text: Turn ExcerLock precise location off but leave Always on. If you can, also turn the harness's own precise location off in iOS Settings for a second run, then tap I did this in ExcerLock... permission changed.
Walk to the gym and tap I'm in the gym at the desk.
Record what ExcerLock shows and try Check in if you can.

scenarios.title: Permission granted after arrival
scenarios.captainWords: grant permission once I'm already there
scenarios.refExpectation: on re-registration iOS answers requestState with inside; the harness re-registers its own region at the same moment via Probe re-register and logs what iOS sends
scenarios.prodExpectation: observe the card within 2 minutes of granting

steps.text: Arrive at the gym with ExcerLock denied and tap I'm in the gym.
Grant ExcerLock Always in iOS Settings, tap I did this in ExcerLock... permission changed, then tap Probe re-register on the harness.
Watch ExcerLock for 2 minutes and record what the card shows.

scenarios.title: Screen locked during arrival
scenarios.captainWords: phone in my pocket when I walk in
scenarios.refExpectation: the enter arrives in the background; the port confirms at +30 s on its ticker while production needs a second execution opportunity
scenarios.prodExpectation: the observation at the desk tells whether confirmation settled headlessly

steps.text: Start 200 m out, lock the phone, and walk in with it locked. Tap Away before locking.
Unlock at the desk and tap I'm in the gym. If you forgot, use Oops, I forgot a tap with about 30 s ago.
Record what ExcerLock shows.

scenarios.title: Multiple visits in one day
scenarios.refExpectation: three intervals; minutes union per local day; the event condition is met once per day
scenarios.prodExpectation: the card shows met/present accordingly

steps.text: Visit the gym three times today, at least 30 minutes apart. Tap I'm in the gym on each arrival and Away on each departure.

scenarios.title: Day boundary while inside
scenarios.refExpectation: the interval continues; projectGymHistory splits at local midnight only, the configurable day boundary is not applied there
scenarios.prodExpectation: observe whether the card re-arms

steps.text: Set the ExcerLock day boundary to a near time in Settings, then stay inside the gym across it and tap I'm in the gym.
Write the boundary time in a label note and record what the card shows just before and after.

scenarios.title: Two overlapping gyms
scenarios.refExpectation: both regions are inside and both intervals open; minutes must not double count
scenarios.prodExpectation: one card per condition; reported

steps.text: Register a second gym circle that overlaps the first on the harness Gym card and in ExcerLock, then stand in the overlap.
Record what ExcerLock shows.

scenarios.title: Airplane mode, no network
scenarios.refExpectation: GPS-only fixes; region events are still expected because Core Location works offline; report accuracy
scenarios.prodExpectation: as S02

steps.text: Turn Wi-Fi and cellular off, then start at least 300 m away in the Away place and walk to the gym.
Tap I'm in the gym at the desk.

scenarios.title: Low Power Mode on
scenarios.refExpectation: same expectations as S02 and S05; latencies are reported separately so the cost is visible
scenarios.prodExpectation: as S02 and S05

steps.text: Turn Low Power Mode on, then arrive on foot from at least 300 m away and tap Away then I'm in the gym.
Stay a few minutes, then walk out past the circle and tap Away.

scenarios.title: Reboot while inside
scenarios.captainWords: reboot the phone at the gym
scenarios.refExpectation: the harness recovers the archive as interrupted; the production exit after reboot is the finding
scenarios.prodExpectation: observe after leaving whether the card cleared

steps.text: Be inside the gym, in the I'm in the gym place, confirmed.
Reboot the phone, unlock it, and reopen the harness. Tap I did this in ExcerLock... phone rebooted.
Walk away from the gym and tap Away, then record what ExcerLock shows.

scenarios.title: Free session
scenarios.refExpectation: no expected table; the validator prints the timeline and latencies only
scenarios.prodExpectation: reported only

steps.text: Record whatever happens. Tap the place cards as you go and Finish when you are done.
